articles.summary: By the time you finish reading this, someone at Wix is probably in the middle of a data migration. We've run migrations that lasted anywhere from a few months to two years. More recently, we've completed large and complex migrations in a few weeks. The difference wasn't the tooling, which barely changed. It was that we had finally learned which problems show up in every migration, and started dealing with them before the migration began instead of in the middle of it.Recap: Why We Migrate, And H
articles.title: 5 Billion Records, 10 Terabytes, Four Weeks: A Real Data Migration Playbook
